doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Tonight Show drummers Ed Shaughnessy and Grady Tate
summary: Young and Brown try to recall the show's drummers; he praises Ed Shaughnessy and his friend Grady Tate.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: So Ed Shaughnessy was the main drummer, right? For the Tonight Show?
Yeah.
So he must have been a monster for…
Beg your pardon?
I said, he must have been a monster reader…
Oh yeah.
And could do everything.
Oh yeah, and he was, man he didn‘t miss nothing.
Okay.
He was very good. Ed Shaughnessy. In New York they had… could you remember the guys they had in New York? They had the drummer… Sonny, no not Sonny Payne, but…oh man…
Drummer right? We‘re looking at the drummers. Mel Lewis…
No.
Dennis Mackrel?
Who?
Well Mel Lewis or Dennis Mackrel? John Riley? Am I looking at the wrong one? Hang on, no that‘s, no sorry, sorry, sorry no, I‘m sorry, sorry, that‘s I‘m sorry…
Not on the Tonight Show.
Sorry that was me. Let‘s see, Jack Sperling, or Shelly Mann, Louie Bellson?
Now, they were on…
Or Grady Tate?
Not New York.
New York would be, how about Grady Tate?
Grady Tate, that‘s who I was thinking about.
Okay.
Grady Tate. Now we had worked together, what band was that? Ah Snooky, Grady Tate, you know Grady Tate?
Yeah, I don‘t, yeah I know who he is.
He‘s tough man.
Oh yeah.
He‘s tough, Grady Tate, man. Did he play with Basie? Who did he play with?
He recorded on Oliver Nelson‘s stuff.
Yeah he was on Oliver Nelson, he played a lot with Oliver.
Oliver Nelson?
Yeah.

Maybe it was Oliver Nelson I‘m thinking of, Grady Tate, Oliver Nelson Band. Well, anyways, I worked with Grady, Grady Tate and I we real good friends, man. Grady‘s about your size and we was just about the same size and we used to, oh man. Grady Tate, he‘s a great cat, man. He‘s still around, you know. I‘d like to see him, I haven‘t seen him in years, but we were very good friends, man, and when he came on the Tonight Show that was really something man. He came on in there and did it, he came on in there and did it, man. He came behind… because they had to have two or three drummers; one didn‘t do the same thing everyday they had to have, what‘s the guy‘s name, the big guy we just mentioned, played drums?
We got Louie Bellson, you had, who did I mention, Louie Bellson, I mentioned…
Louie Bellson didn‘t do the Tonight Show.
Okay, Jack Sperling or Shelly Man? Jack Sperling was in, in a…
They did other shows, they didn‘t do the Tonight Show…
Okay.
Everyday. What‘s his name? Damn it.
Not Louie Bellson, though, huh? Not Louie?
Ed Shaughnessy!
Oh, Ed.
Yeah.
